name: Casey Noir and Carved Pumpkin's Latte
source:
A point and click, "Who Done It?", murder mystery visual novel, set in a Gothic Hotel on top of a lonely hill, during the Night of Halloween.

Step into the shoes of Casey Noir, an immortal, shadowy detective, who was invited to a Halloween party at a gothic hotel by a familiar face.

Unfortunately, the reunion is cut short when one of the guests is murdered, with the murderer being one of the guests still present. 

Investigate the hotel and its surroundings, chat with suspects, collect evidence, and dig to the bottom of what's exactly going on this Halloween. The masks of the party-goers conceal, detract, and lie.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3840970/]Steam[/url]]
